original: The Natural Park of Corralejo () is a Spanish protected area of the municipality of La Oliva to the north of Fuerteventura (Canary Islands). It has more than 2600 hectares. It was classified as a natural park in 1994. They are the main tourist attractions of the island after its white sandy beaches. They are the largest dune of the Canary Islands
